_comment: Source of truth for hal0 runner images. TWO orthogonal axes: (1) `ownership` = does the Dockerfile live in THIS repo (owned) or in an upstream repo we only pin (referenced); (2) `publish` = who builds+pushes the canonical image. publish values: 'ci' = THIS repo's build-matrix.yml builds+pushes it (only comfyui today; future new owned images e.g. vibevoice); 'external' = Dockerfile is archived here for provenance/reproducibility, but the canonical published image comes from another lineage — CI must NOT rebuild/repush it (would 403 on the pre-existing org package and/or overwrite the canonical artifact), we only pin its digest; 'manual' = referenced source repo builds it, pin only. The plan job builds ONLY publish=='ci'. scripts/emit-manifest.sh resolves the published ghcr digest for EVERY image with a manifest_key and PRs it into Hal0ai/hal0 manifest.json — independent of publish. rocmfpx/vulkanfpx use an app-side pin (DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE, schema.py) rather than manifest.json.toolbox_images. Hand-built runner recipes live in runners/ (build.sh + manifest.toml; publish 'external' = built on the build host, never by CI). Non-runner build targets (the strix base, the Vulkan server) are NOT catalogue rows and live in build-recipes.json, because every entry here becomes a slot-selectable row in hal0's Runner Images page. SCHEMA NOTE: `images` is an ARRAY (hal0's runner-image sync — src/hal0/registry/runner_image_sync.py — requires a list); each entry carries its short name in `id`. RUNTIME METADATA (Hal0ai/hal0 feat/catalogue-runtime-metadata): `runtime_family` = the runtime the image's entrypoint serves, same vocabulary as hal0's RuntimeFamily (src/hal0/runners/__init__.py); `supported_backends` = backends the runner binary can execute, same semantics as Runner.supported_backends (metadata, not a selector). hal0's sync merges both onto catalogue rows so the slot drawer's catalogued-pin lane stops assuming every row is llama-server.

images.notes: llama.cpp CPU-only build (GGML_VULKAN/CUDA/HIP=OFF, GGML_NATIVE=OFF so the binary is portable across x86_64 instead of tuned to the builder; hal0#2126 — the `cpu` runner previously carried the Vulkan GPU toolbox and SIGILLed on GPU-less boxes). cpu/Dockerfile is synced byte-for-byte from Hal0ai/hal0 packaging/toolbox/cpu.Dockerfile (2026-10-04); the consumed :v1 digest is pinned in hal0 manifest.json toolbox_images.cpu and was published by hal0's toolbox.yml. LLAMA_CPP_REF still defaults to master (unpinned), so only the digest makes the shipped build reproducible; pin it before the next rebuild.

FastFlowLM v0.9.44 on AMD XDNA2 NPU. FLM_REF build-arg controls upstream tag. Migrated as-is from app repo; BUILD-VERIFIED 2026-07-19 (full XRT+Rust+FastFlowLM build completes clean on the build host; runtime needs the NPU).

Kokoro-82M TTS (CPU ONNX). Dockerfile RECONSTRUCTED from image history 2026-07-19; rebuild-VERIFIED same day (built clean + container serves, /health 200 model_loaded=true, 54 voices, default af_bella).

Moonshine STT (CPU/Vulkan). Dockerfile RECONSTRUCTED from ghcr config blob 2026-07-19; rebuild-VERIFIED same day (built clean + container serves, /health 200 model_loaded=true, model_id moonshine-small_streaming-en).
Qwen3-TTS multilingual GPU TTS (ROCm). Migrated as-is from app repo packaging/toolbox. BUILD-VERIFIED 2026-07-19 (builds clean on the build host; runtime needs GPU+model).

NEW hal0-owned ComfyUI (gfx1151 ROCm). Replaces third-party docker.io/kyuz0/amd-strix-halo-comfyui. Single ROCm image — no vulkan variant (see comfyui/README.md). All build inputs pinned 2026-07-19: fedora base by digest, torch triple by dated nightly (cp313 @ 20260501), ComfyUI + 3 nodes by commit SHA. SMOKE-TESTED on gfx1151: builds, ROCm torch sees Radeon 8060S; ComfyUI 0.28.0 detects Total VRAM 118784 MB (~116 GiB GTT, native, NORMAL_VRAM) + gfx1151 + ROCm 7.13. Remaining before publish: push :latest + digest-pin in app manifest.

Legacy per-backend llama.cpp Vulkan toolbox. NO LIVE BUILDER: amd-strix-halo-toolboxes' build_and_publish.yml targets kyuz0's Docker Hub and its ghcr-publish.yml pushes only ghcr.io/hal0ai/amd-strix-halo-toolboxes:*-server, never hal0-toolbox-vulkan. Dead pin: hal0 manifest.json toolbox_images.vulkan still carries a digest, but no runner resolves it (hal0 src/hal0/runners/__init__.py keeps rocmfpx off the vulkan/rocm manifest keys on purpose). The fork's live Vulkan server recipe (FALLBACK_VULKAN_IMAGE lineage) now lives in llama-vulkan/ here. build.dockerfile records the historical source path only.

Legacy per-backend llama.cpp ROCm toolbox (multi-arch gfx1030..gfx1151). NO LIVE BUILDER: nothing in amd-strix-halo-toolboxes (or anywhere else) publishes hal0-toolbox-rocm. Dead pin: hal0 manifest.json toolbox_images.rocm still carries a digest, but no runner resolves it. GPU boxes run rocmfpx-combined (runners/rocmfpx here). build.dockerfile records the historical source path only.

Canonical ROCmFPX+Vulkan combined runner (llama-server). Recipe: runners/rocmfpx/ here (moved from Hal0ai/hal0 packaging/runner/rocmfpx/); hand-built on the build host with build.sh, not by CI. Tag pinned app-side (DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE = :0826). No pinned tag here on purpose: the hal0 catalogue tracks tags/list so fresh pushes surface on sync.

Pristine-upstream llama.cpp variant of the combined runner (adds qwen4exp / Qwen3.8-Flash-Next; lacks ROCmFPX quant formats and the MiniCPM5/LFM2.5 patches). Recipe: runners/upstream/ here (moved from Hal0ai/hal0 packaging/runner/upstream/); wire to slots ONLY via per-slot image_pin, never as the default. Temporary: retire per Hal0ai/hal0#2118 once ROCmFPX syncs qwen4exp.

Hy3 variant of the FPX runner: adds IFP2 (ggml type107) + minicpm5 + the hy_v3 NextN/MTP patch so Hy3-Chadrock-FPX-IFP2-MTP loads. Built 2026-07-14 on the former build host; was local-only until pushed to ghcr 2026-07-19. Both floating tag :ifp2-hyv3-mtp and digest-named :ifp2-hyv3-d7e1f26 share manifest sha256:dbb443fc… (config/image id 57aaafb773b1). Builder toolchain localhost/hal0-rocmfpx-builder:7.2.4 (may or may not be pushed). Referenced, digest-pinned; app follow-up: repin [profile.hy3-fpx] from :ifp2-hyv3-mtp to the digest. hy3 slot enabled=false (91GB weights can't co-reside with agent slot on 128GB).

images.notes: Accelerated HIP-only runner (GGML_VULKAN=OFF) for jcbtc/Qwen3.8-27B-CIRU-ActiveFPX-PromptForge — OPTIONAL, mutually exclusive with hal0-combined, never the general default. ciru-ai tree (ciru's gfx1151 Vulkan defect never executes in a HIP-only build) + the card's 627-line Output-K8 runtime patch. Recipe: runners/promptforge/ here (moved from Hal0ai/hal0 packaging/runner/promptforge/), hand-built on the build host. Gate hal0#1891 passed 2026-08-30 on this digest; hal0 manifest.json toolbox_images.promptforge pins it, so manifest_key is set.

images.app_pin: DEFAULT_STRIX_IMAGE (src/hal0/config/schema.py) + manifest.json toolbox_images.strix (same digest); gate 2026-08-31 passed
images.notes: Vulkan-only (GGML_HIP=OFF) llama-server from the r/StrixHalo production snapshot (myhacsint/llama.cpp @ 5d43efe26): qwen4exp + NextN/MTP (--spec-type draft-mtp, adaptive) + --tensor-read-lazy. OPTIONAL runner, never the AMD default; successor to the combined-upstream :0829 pin for qwen4exp (hal0#2118). No FPX-family quant support. Digest is the image the 2026-08-31 gate validated on a kfd-present and a kfd-absent box. GGML_NATIVE=ON: build only on a strix-halo-class host, never in GitHub CI. A rebuild is a new digest and needs a new gate.
